items.title: Rhythm behind the stumps helps Litton break batting slump
items.summary: While his bat finally came alive, Litton’s work behind the stumps had already been a standout feature of the Test.

items.title: Visas in limbo as U-19s sweat on clearance for Oman tour
items.summary: Bangladesh’s Under-19 cricket team are scheduled to fly to Oman at 7:30 am on Tuesday, but with fewer than eight hours remaining before departure, it is still uncertain on Monday night whether the players and coaching staff would be able to travel for their Youth ODI series against Afghanistan.

items.title: Litton backs spinners to seal Bangladesh victory on Day 5
items.summary: Wicketkeeper-batter Litton Das is counting on Bangladesh’s spinners to make an impact on the final day as the Tigers push for victory in their one-off Test against Afghanistan in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Litton Das century cements Bangladesh's ascendancy
items.summary: Afghanistan were left with seven wickets and were 347 away from their 479-run target

items.title: From four ducks to a Test ton: Litton makes his statement
items.summary: Despite Bangladesh’s historic success in their latest series in Australia, Litton endured a personal nightmare, failing to score in all three innings in which he got the opportunity to bat.

items.title: Bangladesh need 7 wickets, Afghanistan 347 runs in final-day equation
items.summary: Earlier in the day, Litton Das struck his seventh Test century before Bangladesh, who scored 346 in their first innings, declared their second innings at 372 for seven.

items.title: Hasan’s domination continues with immaculate length management
items.summary: Hasan Mahmud’s Test career has hit a purple patch over the last few months, and a maiden Test hattrick is the icing on the cake as his skill set in the red-ball format continues to grow.

items.title: Mushfiqur, Shanto give Bangladesh big lead after Mahmud, Ebadot dismantle Afghanistan
items.summary: Bangladesh ended the third day of the one-off Test in Abu Dhabi 329 runs ahead with four second-innings wickets in hand

items.title: Mostary: I am so happy about my century
items.summary: She made 118 off 134 against Australia in Brisbane, the highest score by a Bangladesh batter in ODIs

items.title: Rahmat, Malik fifties lead Afghanistan's strong reply
items.summary: Afghanistan managed to chip away at Bangladesh's 346 all-out and were only 135 away by stumps on the second day

items.title: Aliss Al Islam in Litton-led Bangladesh squad for ODI tri-series

items.title: Afghanistan fast bowlers hit back after Bangladesh's strong start

items.title: Sutherland and Litchfield lead Australia to quick and convincing win in ODI series opener
items.summary: Bangladesh were bowled out for 166 with only Ritu Moni showing any intent with the bat, and it took Australia just 25.4 overs to finish off the chase

items.title: Bangladesh opt to bat and pick Nayeem Hasan
items.summary: Bangladesh opted for Ebadot Hossain in place of Shoriful Islam while Afghanistan went for a batting-heavy line-up

items.title: Sultana: Bangladesh 'can surprise any team when we perform as a whole unit'
items.summary: The Bangladesh captain and coach David Hemp emphasised a positive mindset ahead of their first ever ODI in Australia

items.title: Stand-in captain McGrath has 'absolutely no idea' about her batting position

items.title: Afghanistan look to tick boxes in rare Test outing against confident Bangladesh
